topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Oh no, I just heard about the tree, the one you planted, you know, way back when you were little. It’s gone? Can you even believe it? I mean, I know that thing meant the world to you, it was like a silent witness to all your childhood, right? It just doesn’t seem real. We always talked about how it grew with you, in a way. I’m sure it's a mess of emotions right now. What are they thinking, just cutting it down like that? Doesn’t make any sense. But, hey, maybe there’s a way to mark the spot or something, keep the memory alive. What do you think?
